fullPassage: Intuition can be great, but it ought to be hard-earned. Experts, for example, are able to think on their feet because they’ve invested thousands of hours in learning and practice: their intuition has become data-driven. Yet most people are not experts, though they often think they are. Most of us, especially when we interact with others on social media, act with expert-like speed and conviction, offering a wide range of opinions on global crises, without the substance of knowledge that supports it. And thanks to AI, which ensures that our messages are delivered to an audience more inclined to believing it, our delusions of expertise can be reinforced by our personal filter bubble. We have an interesting tendency to find people more open-minded, rational, and sensible when they think just like us.

det.korean: 필터 버블에 의해 전문성 착각이 강화(reinforced)된다는 내용이다.
det.analysis: 정답: reinforced — 본문 "our delusions of expertise can be reinforced by our personal filter bubble"에서 직접 확인 가능

questions.passage: Intuition can be great, but it ought to be hard-earned. Experts, for example, are able to think on their feet because they’ve invested thousands of hours in learning and practice: their intuition has become data-driven. Yet most people are not experts, though they often think they are. Most of us, especially when we interact with others on social media, act with expert-like speed and conviction, offering a wide range of opinions on global crises, without the substance of knowledge that supports it. And thanks to AI, which ensures that our messages are delivered to an audience more inclined to believing it, our delusions of expertise can be reinforced by our personal filter bubble. We have an interesting tendency to find people more open-minded, rational, and sensible when they think just like us.
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문과 일치하면 True, 아니면 False.
"본문에서 hard-earned(힘들게 얻은)과 관련된 내용이 언급된다."

det.korean: 진술 "본문에서 hard-earned(힘들게 얻은)과 관련된 내용이 언급된다."은 본문의 내용과 일치한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① True ❌ ② False ✅ True: 본문에서 해당 내용을 직접 확인할 수 있다.
❌ False: 본문과 일치하므로 False는 오답.
